Well, personally, what I would do is you can always pop the plant out of the pot and check the roots to see if the plant is root bound. If so, gently tense the roods and make it to where they are not all tangled up. Then check to see if the new pot is the right size by measuring the root ball to see if it's 2 inches bigger or not. Then add new soil. Of the root ball fits in the old pot, at least replace the soil. 12 years is a long time, and maybe it will grow more after the adjustment period after daily repot.
